name: Repository listing
responsibility: Turns the checkout registry into the repositories the navigator lists: each identity's chosen checkout, its vault and its state, and the names of the vaults
description: An identity is listed when any known checkout has a vault in the .archboard/vault layout; its state is ready, no-vault, gone or unchosen. The registry is the only source: no environment variable names a vault (TASK-472.09). A vault whose link leads out of the layout is no vault here, because every call to it is refused: its checkout reads no-vault, and an untracked one is not listed. placeOfVault(vault) answers its home vault, its repository's name, its checkout and whether that checkout is chosen; it absorbs both repositoryOfVault names, so a show, a pane's starting place, a thread's label and the CLI's canvas address all ask it (TASK-653.10). A vault that no registry entry holds has no repository name, and its checkout is the directory that holds it.
